as_told.title: F. Lee Bailey on CIA retainer (index 4)

plain: In 1973, when James McCord, one of the men arrested in the Watergate break-in, was in legal trouble, the famous defence lawyer F. Lee Bailey was secretly on what the lawyer Dan Sheehan calls the CIA's "index 4", according to Sheehan. In one telling, Sheehan says he learned this first-hand at the time; in another, he credits two people he names as Andy Toney and William Johnstone Taylor, and adds that Bailey was one of four lawyers the CIA kept on retainer. If true, it would mean the CIA had its own man close to McCord's defence.
